settings.headline: The Healthy Hand
settings.details:
The Healthy Hand is a All Natural Health & Wellness Company which provides all natural products containing a variety of antioxidants formulated in healing herbs to help prevent and fighting diseases. 

For countless years, people from various cultures have relied on medical plants as a means to heal and repair the mind, body, and spirit dating back to 3000 BC. 

Natural herbs have been known to calm everything from your anxiety, panic attacks, severe depression, Alzheimer’s and more. In addition, although the herbs are relatively safe, they should be used with caution, as directed on products, and/ or as directed by your doctor or physician.

Many herbs can be taken in tea form, which can often be just as effective as taking capsules. Some herbs are better taken in liquid or powder form. 

Our mission is to provide Healthy and Wellness herbs to help you live a better daily lifestyle. Allow The Healthy Hand to be a helping hand to you!

settings.title: CAN YOU TAKE BOTH “TOTAL BELLY DETOX AND TOTAL SYSTEM DETOX TOGETHER?
settings.answer: Yes you can definitely take both of our detox together. Our Detox is our number one selling product which is amazing taken by itself but together it is a powerhouse. If you choose to take both Detox together we suggest you take a half a tablespoon of each mix together in a water bottle, create a tea, or add to smoothie.

settings.title: HOW MUCH WATER SHOULD I CONSUME PER DAY WITH YOUR DETOX?
settings.answer: It is best to consume at least 3 to 4 water bottles per day after you have taken the detox. Water helps to flush your system and allows our detox to maximize its potential and work properly through your system. (JUST WATER)

settings.title: WHEN IS THE BEST TIME TO TAKE THE DETOX?
settings.answer: The best time to take our detox is before bed or while you’re home or somewhere comfortable near a restroom. If you’re in the restroom more then normal that means the product is definitely working through your system. To slow down the detoxification minimize your dosage.

settings.title: HOW TO TAKE BLACK SEED OIL?
settings.answer: Black seed oil can be consumed in either capsule or liquid form. With our liquid form we suggest, if consuming the liquid form, taking 1 teaspoon per day or as needed or recommended by your doctor or physician. However, due to its strong flavor, you may want to mix the oil with honey or lemon juice before ingesting.
